resources.string: Checking the complete password for known breaches…
This password is common or easily guessed. Choose a different password, such as a longer passphrase with unrelated words.
This password appears in known breach data. Choose a different password that you have not used elsewhere.
The password check could not be completed. Please try again.

This password passed the small offline blocklist, but the online breach check could not finish. You can continue with a pending check. When you are online, sign in with your master password to complete it. If it appears in breach data, SafeKey will ask you to change it.
Enter your current password and a different new password. Your saved vault items will be kept. Sign in with the new password after the change.
Choose a new master password that differs from the current password.
Master password changed. Sign in with your new password.
The password could not be changed. Check your current password and try again.
An online breach check is pending. When you are online, sign in with your master password to complete it.
Your master password appears in known breach data. Change it to protect your vault.
